items.title: Mayfield, Matthews Tabbed With Sun Belt Weekly Honors
items.summary: RUSTON – Louisiana Tech linebacker Jadon Mayfield and punter Lexington Matthews were named Sun Belt Conference Defensive and Special Teams Players of the Week, respectively, the league announced Monday following the Bulldogs' 63-31 victory over Southern Miss on Saturday.

items.title: Bulldogs Clinch Sun Belt West Division Title With 63-31 Victory Over Southern Miss
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech secured the Sun Belt Conference West Division championship in emphatic fashion Saturday afternoon, scoring a series-record 63 points and returning two interceptions for touchdowns in a 63-31 victory over Southern Miss at Joe Aillet Stadium.

items.title: Preview: LA Tech vs. Southern Miss
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech returns to Origin Bank Field at Joe Aillet Stadium on Saturday as the Bulldogs welcome longtime rival Southern Miss for a Sun Belt Conference showdown. The upcoming matchup will be the first time LA Tech and Southern Miss meet as conference opponents since the 2021 season.

items.title: Eli Finley Named John Mackey Award Semifinalist
items.summary: RUSTON – Louisiana Tech's Eli Finley was named one of nine semifinalists on Wednesday for the John Mackey Award, which is presented to the nation's most outstanding tight end.

items.title: Alonzo Jackson Jr. Named SBC Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: RUSTON – Linebacker Alonzo Jackson Jr. was named the Sun Belt's Defensive Player of the Week, per the league office's announcement Monday afternoon. It is the first weekly honor of his career, and the third time a Bulldog has received SBC weekly honors this season, joining Dedrick Latulas (Week 1 SBC Special Teams POTW) and Blake Baker (Week 6 SBC Offensive POTW).
